observations: OutboxIntent contains generic effect identity, status, attempt, lease, receipt, ambiguity and dead-letter fields
WhatsAppOutboundEffect correlates a local Message with one effect and provider message ID
Conversation and Message can persist inbox data but current inbound WhatsApp does not use persistence-before-acknowledgement
AutomationLog is execution-summary oriented and has no ordered durable step-attempt model
AI chat messages persist conversational tool-call JSON but there is no dedicated proposal/approval model

currentBehavior: Node instrumentation starts WhatsApp and courier workers
workers import the process-active db and ShopContext
workers drain only the currently opened shop database
license failure leaves durable work queued for a later tick
workerOwnership.openContract: define active versus inactive shop execution, visible pending state and safe shop-switch/quiescence behavior

preservedBehavior: outbound message and encrypted intent commit before provider dispatch
effect identity includes exact shop incarnation and paired account binding
pre-effect retry is distinguished from post-effect ambiguity
sidecar durable receipt lookup prevents repeat send after restart
operator retry requires explicit duplicate-risk confirmation for ambiguous outcomes
concurrent workers cannot claim one effect twice
gaps: Baileys uses an in-memory chat/message store
messages.upsert emits inbound messages to subscribers without durable acknowledgement
chats and messages routes merge live sidecar history with durable outbound rows only
inbound message identity, raw evidence, deduplication, quarantine and replay are missing
delivery-status callback remains best-effort fire-and-forget when the app is unavailable
daily-report and automation callers require complete durable-effect adoption audit

knownCallers: canonical and compatibility order creation/status flows
gaps: dispatch is fire-and-forget and catches all failures
matching automations execute concurrently through Promise.allSettled
multi-step execution continues after failed steps
overall run is recorded as success after any number of failed steps
retries are in-process sleeps and do not survive restart
send_whatsapp calls sidecar status and send endpoints directly
there is no stable run identity, ordered step attempt or step-to-effect receipt
unknown or skipped actions lack a complete operator recovery contract

preservedBehavior: AI order creation can use a stable persisted session/proposal source identity
canonical AI order creation produces a draft rather than silently confirming
tool results are redacted before being fed back to Gemini
gaps: confirmation is a generic token in the current user message
the model can emit a new tool call and arguments on the confirmation turn
there is no dedicated persisted proposal hash or approval row
target record versions, permissions, entitlement and expiry are not one approval authority
several sensitive tools still use direct or compatibility mutations
streaming response persistence failure is swallowed after delivery
approval and execution results are not one durable recoverable state machine

preservedBehavior: canonical order and reservation authority is verified before booking
booking effect commits before provider dispatch
worker lease, retry, ambiguity and manual reconciliation exist
tracking events are normalized into canonical delivery authority
gaps: provider mechanics use separate effect implementation from WhatsApp
current/reviewed-base/legacy layering complicates audit and maintenance
adapter implementation is not equivalent to current live certification
DHD explicitly uses unverified guessed endpoints but is registered normally
capability-specific provider certification is not server-side authority

preservedBehavior: canonical source order commands are used for new imports
provider cancellations use governed order decisions/recovery when possible
checkpoint does not advance if any fetched order fails
gaps: sync execution is synchronous request work
there is no durable sync-run, page/event or per-item attempt record
errors are returned as strings rather than durable quarantine/dead-letter state
webhook and polling convergence is not a complete persisted protocol
manual replay, overlap reconciliation and history UI are incomplete
